status: Dedicated physical OFF clamp added; assembly resistance, source current and shutdown timing unqualified
placement: U6 beside U4, supplied and grounded at U4 VIN/GND, with the local B-rail bypass. CT open. Layout, bypass effectiveness and loaded envelope still require design; no extra capacitor is silently assumed.
conditional_assumptions: Apply the 100 nA SENSE sink limit measured at 5 V across the actual PG voltage; its source-current bound is not specified.
Apply the 1 V unpowered PG limit between the two characterized sink currents, only with A below 2.35 V and eFuse EN below 0.45 V. These test points do not qualify arbitrary pin states.
The RESET low-level calculation requires total ENABLE source current at most 0.4 mA. The module's nominal 100 kohm pull-up is not a tolerance or USB-coupling bound.

physical_off.placement: Pole 1 retains cell isolation and A discharge. Wire pole 2 terminal 5 directly to U4 ENABLE and terminal 4 back to U4 GND as a dedicated pair; insulate unused terminal 6. Do not terminate the clamp return at the cell or shared LED ground. Retain U6 and U7. This replaces S1, not an additional switch. The wider DPDT body, six lugs, guard and loaded leads must enter the eventual CAD/BOM before freeze.
physical_off.contact_material: G gold over silver: pole 1 reserved for power, pole 2 reserved for low-level operation; never repurpose a power-used pole as a dry contact.
remaining_evidence: Maximum working contact resistance over dry-circuit use, temperature and wear; the catalogue's below-10-milliohm value is typical initial at 100 mA, not a guarantee at ENABLE current
Both conductors and four solder terminations, local return displacement and full ENABLE source current including module pull-up, U6/U7 leakage and USB coupling
Pole sequencing and bounce, capacitor discharge through the clamp, maximum time to stable closure and module shutdown delay; the settled DC result supplies no timed OFF or reset guarantee
Cell removal while ON and retained/USB-powered rails still require U6/U7 and a complete circuit-state model; this pole only clamps when its OFF contact is closed
Independent fitted routing, wider switch envelope, insulation and per-design mass before compartment freeze
